verdict.rationale: Xero has a built-in AI assistant, JAX, described as an 'AI finance partner' that reconciles transactions and lets users create/edit/send invoices via plain-language commands, plus separate AI-based bill-detail extraction — all first-party evidence of task delegation to an in-product assistant. However all evidence is vendor marketing copy with no hands-on/independent verification of how broad or reliable JAX's task delegation actually is. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of JAX in real use, and evidence of broader task coverage beyond reconciliation/invoicing/bill extraction.
